title: The Element in Half the Worlds
subtitle: Frankl’s conjecture and the structure of union-closed families
status: Open conjecture; full-tier documentary exposition; no proof claim
claim_boundary: This is a source-normalized illustrated documentary. It does not prove Frankl's conjecture, establish a new universal frequency bound, certify unreviewed proof claims, or make a novelty, priority, or public-release claim.

plates.label: Cover
plates.title: The Element in Half the Worlds
plates.alt: An illuminated navy, cream, and gold cover showing overlapping set-worlds, element nodes, and the exact half-frequency conjecture.

plates.label: Plate I
plates.title: The Garden That Closes
plates.alt: A branching garden of finite sets flows upward to their pairwise unions, contrasting local closure with the global search for an abundant element.

plates.label: Plate II
plates.title: The Half-Way Balance
plates.alt: A brass balance compares one element’s frequency with half the number of sets, above the incidence-counting identity linking all frequencies to total set size.

plates.label: Plate III
plates.title: The Entropy Bridge
plates.alt: A uniform random set passes through coordinate entropies and coupled unions to a dimension-free constant lower bound that still falls short of one half.

plates.label: Plate IV
plates.title: The Lattice Cathedral
plates.alt: A finite join-semilattice rises from bottom to top through atoms, joins, and irreducible elements, illustrating the lattice formulation and deletion routes.

plates.label: Plate V
plates.title: The Certificate Forge
plates.alt: A formal forge separates exact finite replay, Lean theorems, imported results, hybrid packages, source audits, and the universal conjecture’s claim boundary.

plates.label: Plate VI
plates.title: Islands of Theorem
plates.alt: Islands representing special families, rigorous constant bounds, and formal lattice results approach but do not reach the open one-half threshold.
